note: Popov-Chang syndrome (YWHAZ) presents with intellectual disability/developmental delay and nonspecific anomalies, making the absence of severe classic lissencephaly (hallmark of YWHAE/Miller-Dieker) a plausible discriminator.

evidence.text: YWHAZ variants are shown to cause intellectual disability and developmental delay without classic lissencephaly phenotypes, supporting its distinction from other 14-3-3 related severe malformations.

source.title: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global ...
source.quote: To investigate the role of YWHAZ gene in intellectual disability and global developmental delay, we conducted whole-exon sequencing in all of the available members from a large three-generation family and we discovered that a novel variant of the YWHAZ gene was associated with intellectual disability and global developmental delay.

evidence.text: Popov-Chang Syndrome (POPCHAS) is characterized by global developmental delay, intellectual impairment, speech deficits, and dysmorphism rather than severe classic lissencephaly or limb reduction defects.
